blends.name: Lucky Cup
blends.desc:
This Lucky Cup NFT is part of the Mundo Bitcoin collectibles. By owning this NFT Lucky Cup you can participate in all the raffles that are carried out or will be carried out within the Mundo Bitcoin community, YouTube channel and all its social networks.

To create an NFT Lucky Cup you need to own and burn 6 NFTs of the edition (season1) of different rarities explained below:

- 1 Legendary
- 3 Common

The NFTs of the edition (btcadventur) can be obtained in the AtomicHub market or by purchasing the packages available here: https://wax.atomichub.io/market?collection_name=mundobitcoin&order=asc&schema_name=season1&sort=price&symbol=WAX
